metadata.title: Bamboo Shoots With Green Chilies | Mizo Recipe
metadata.description:
Mizo cuisine offers a wide range of interesting recipe which are zesty and flavorful. The food culture in Mizoram is as vibrant and interesting as the Mizo people and their culture.

Food preparation is often very simple with no unwanted elaboration but the food is zesty and flavorful. 

There are some amazing chutney like dishes which I love eating and one such simple but flavorful dish is Routai made of fresh bamboo shoots and fresh green chilies. This is a chutney type dish and can be used as side with meals .
